title: Coverage analysis project profile
description: Everything project-specific lives here. A new project = a new profiles/<name>/profile.json + conventions.md; no code changes.

acSources.description: Which story parsers to use, in priority order. uc-doc = structured UC-NN QA scenario docs (parsed by script, 0 tokens).

nonTestable.description: Rule-based triage (0 tokens). Anything not matched here or recognised as testable goes to the LLM triage stage.

linkTypesToFollow.description: Issue link types whose other end also counts for coverage (e.g. a TESTING story <-> its dev story).

skipTitlePattern.description: UCs to leave out of atomic test cases (e.g. legacy parity, WCAG audits).

consolidateTitlePattern.description: UCs that become ONE test case with one step per bullet (e.g. permission denial).

featurePathPattern.description: Regex on the story text; capture group 1 = module path under frontendRoot.

searchRoots.description: Extra code the implementation discovery may follow references into (shared frontend services, other backend modules). Cloned too.

backendLinks.description: How a frontend file points at backend code: regex over frontend source, backendFile template using $1.

folderRoot.description: Only cases under this folder path are in scope, e.g. 'Ridango > AVL'.

confluence.description: Optional. Confluence pages as a requirements source (same Atlassian site and token as Jira, under /wiki). Pages are found by title on the module keywords and by links from the in-scope stories.

enabled.description: Default true when this block exists.

spaces.description: Space keys to search; [] = all spaces.

titleExclude.description: Regexes (case-insensitive) on page titles that are never requirements, e.g. "passbolt".

changeHistoryPattern.description: Regex (case-insensitive) on page titles that are change history only, e.g. "release notes". Such pages are listed, not read as requirements.

modules.description: Optional per-module hints. Key = module path (as captured by featurePathPattern).

summaryPattern.description: Assigns stories without a feature path to this module.

zephyrFolder.description: Folder path substring for new cases of this module.
